verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile ships natural-language Copilot chat, so it is fair to ask whether that chat can turn a plain-language request into a shell command. The evidence never says it does. Its Copilot features cover explaining code, navigating repositories, opening pull requests, code review and managing agent tasks. The Copilot CLI and GitHub CLI are separate terminal products, so they earn no credit for the mobile app.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can describe what I want in plain language and have the tool generate the corresponding shell command
